heading: What changed in the two years I led the team.
summary: Access to real-time data fell from 2–3 weeks to 3 days, decryption access from 9 days to 3 days, internal approvals from 24 hours to near-instant, time to discover data from 14.2 hours to 9.4 hours, search session conversion rose from 41% to 61%, peak-season P0/P1 incidents fell from 17 to 0, and clean data grew from under 1% to 80% of the estate.
source: Launch posts of Mar 24, Aug 22 and Sep 18, 2025 and the internal roadmap. The incident and clean-data results are shared by many teams.
